visualCharacteristics: A set of bordered link boxes, each with a bold title, a sub line and a chevron. The buttons variant shows a caption above a blue or coral button.
contentPattern: One row per item: a paragraph with the link (title) and a plain paragraph with the sub line or caption; in buttons, <strong> links render as blue primary and <em> links as coral secondary buttons.
usage: Use for a small group of prominent entry points into key sections of the site.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for boxed or button-style entry links with a single sub line; pick link-list for long link lists or cards when items have images.
